quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: At a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on your right.
Yield only to traffic on your left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive to the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It warns that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you should prepare to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When you bend your left arm at the elbow and point upward, you are signaling a right turn or right lane change. You can use hand signals instead of or along with your turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, the road curves left. You may see several of these signs along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.
There are trucks on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must and must not do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Come to a full stop, then go if it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection, but you may not need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. You can only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the roadway in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign alerts you to an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready to respond to red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: The lead rider extends their left arm out with palm down, then swings the arm down to their side. This tells riders following behind to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. The lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back. This tells riders following behind to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way directions with a median between them. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: What should you worry about most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not work correctly if one side of your vehicle is higher.
You may damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops off the road onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Make a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection carefully without always stopping.
Stop only if there is traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in or approaching the intersection pass first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and approaching vehicles pass first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic will be joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that from this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to follow traffic rules. This sign means you should stay to the right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for road hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane ends at an exit ramp. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be cautious and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs always mean stop. You must come to a complete stop. Wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to clear before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intentions when turn signals do not work. An arm extended straight to the left means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that wet roads are slippery and hard to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers are on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Drive carefully in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop and yield the right-of-way. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You could have a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and vehicles. Wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop completely before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road you are on ends ahead.
You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What type of situation does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. When conditions are not ideal, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do if you see this sign?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: This sign means passing is not allowed. You must follow all instructions on regulatory signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers that the road ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane. Traffic must merge together.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from bottom to top as green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: Make room for entering vehicles when on a multi-lane roadway. If safe, move to another lane to allow traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum legal speed for the road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning left, even on a green light.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals are used to communicate in group rides. This signal tells all riders to form a single line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully and take special care in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign shape and color mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to show no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road.

questions.question: What does it mean when a motorcycle operator extends their left arm straight out to the left?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals instead of turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the operator plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is not allowed. This sign means U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left-turning vehicles. You cannot use it for passing or going straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope, and the bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride near the road. Drive slowly and watch for bicycles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means when turning left at a green light, you must let oncoming traffic pass first. Turn left only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you there is a sharp turn coming. Slow down before you reach it.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Watch for cars joining the main road.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, hand signals help riders communicate. When the lead rider holds their left arm straight out with palm up and swings it upward, it tells other riders to go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means you cannot do that action. In this case, no right turns are allowed.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass is coming and it may be too low for your vehicle. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that an upcoming bridge is narrow. You may not have room to meet or pass a truck, so be careful.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show their intentions when turn signals are not available. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing up means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction and maintenance signs are orange. This sign warns you that road work is ahead. Slow down and be extra careful when driving through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only flows one way. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter at a low speed and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down as you approach the intersection. Let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is roadwork ahead, so detour right.
The road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road ahead will turn sharply (in this case, to the right). Slow down before you reach the sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show other drivers what you plan to do. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and points down, it means you are going to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will make a sharp right turn and then a sharp left turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Stop completely and let others go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others go first if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others go first if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangle sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green on the bottom on vertical traffic lights. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you which direction to drive on a one-way street. You must follow the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign warns you to slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area. Follow their instructions.

questions.question: What does this signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing from the sides.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther away from the vehicle in front of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill section ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws that you must follow. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is unsafe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane is ending soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you will drive.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right.
